'''Worrita''' was a [[Professor/Legends|professor]] who was [[Marriage/Legends|married]] to [[Worrita (Mrs)|Mrs. Worrita]] and joined [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Sargo VenHalgon]] on a vacation to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] around the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They landed on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where Worrita, VenHalgon and [[Cannison (Minister)|Cannison]] went off hunting. However, they were chased up a cliff by a [[Kilassin]]. They were eventually rescued by the crew of the ''[[Starchaser IV]]''.<ref name="Replacements" />
